text.p: Corriente Resources Inc said Monday it has "encouraging" early drilling results from its joint-venture Taca-Taca porphyry copper and gold project in Argentina.
The project in Salta province is a joint venture with Australia's Broken Hill Proprietary Minerals Co Ltd, which has an option to earn a 60 percent interest in the property.
The mineralization of interest occurs at depths greater than 250 metres and appears to be extensive both vertically and horizontally, the company said in a statement.
Drilling results showed three drill holes which one 44 metre section of 1.32 percent copper and 0.07 grams of gold per tonne, Corriente said.
Widths ranged from 10 metres to 196 metres, with copper grades ranging from 0.02 percent to 1.32 percent and gold grades ranging from 0.04 grams per tonne to 0.14 grams per tonne.
